Repriced from each trial's token usage at the catalog's $4 / $0.20 / $5 / $8 / $20 per million input / cache-read / 5-minute cache-write / 1-hour cache-write / output tokens: $111.42 (+6.6%). tokens.basis: Harbor per-trial input_tokens (includes cached), cache_tokens, output_tokens

notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; Claude Opus 5.5 (medium reasoning) through GitHub Copilot. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply.

Safety stops: 36 trials ended with AgentSafetyStopError, the provider's safety classifier stopping the run. They score 0 unless the verifier still passed. Every attempt at seven tasks was stopped: crack-7z-hash, password-recovery, vulnerable-secret and break-filter-js-from-html (security) and dna-insert, dna-assembly and protein-assembly (biology).

Seven replacements: three Harbor or sandbox infrastructure failures, and three agent exits with code -1 recorded as verified crashes (no provider error in fast-agent's log; a lost HF exec stream), one of them replacing an earlier replacement. Originals are kept as evidence.
One safety-stopped trial (fix-code-vulnerability) still passed its verifier and counts as a pass here, as rewarded timeouts do on this page; bench-run's stricter rule counts it 0 (385/445).

Cost shown is a list-rate estimate repriced from each trial's token usage (bench-run reprice, card-packs catalog 2026-10-09.1): Harbor's fast-agent adapter charged prompt-cache writes as plain input. Recorded $104.50; repriced $111.42 over the same 451 trials. The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed. Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
